Fantasy managers who roster Kyle Pitts Sr. get their answer before most of the country has finished breakfast, with the Atlanta Falcons and Cincinnati Bengals kicking off at 9:30 a.m. ET in Madrid. Pitts caught two passes for 6 yards in the 16-0 loss at Tampa Bay , and that's the kind of week that sends people to the waiver wire.
 Start him anyway. Pitts is a low-end TE1 this week with real touchdown upside, because Cincinnati will be without safety Kyle Dugger and has had trouble with tight ends all season, an issue we flagged in the Bengals' familiar problem in Madrid .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kyle Pitts has turned into a red-zone target
 Nov 1, 2026; Tampa, Florida, USA; Atlanta Falcons tight end Kyle Pitts Sr. (8) catches a pass against Tampa Bay Buccaneers linebacker David Walker (51) during the third quarter at Raymond James Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Nathan Ray Seebeck-Imagn Images
 Pitts has 22 catches for 197 yards and four touchdowns on 32 targets, per his ESPN game log . The yardage won't win anyone a week on its own. He hasn't topped 60 yards in a game, and he played just 29 of Atlanta's 53 offensive snaps at Tampa Bay, according to PFF, with Charlie Woerner taking the same number.
 Break it down by game and every one of Pitts' touchdowns has come in the last four weeks: one against Baltimore, two against Chicago and one against San Francisco. Over the same stretch, he's caught 17 of 23 targets.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cincinnati's linebackers are the ones who'll see him most underneath, and Barrett Carter and Demetrius Knight Jr. combined to allow six catches on eight targets for 75 yards against Tennessee, according to PFF. Titans tight end Gunnar Helm led that game with 76 yards on five catches.
 Michael Penix Jr. also needs short throws he can trust after his four-interception day in Tampa . Pitts is the safest one on the field.
 Falcons' offensive matchups against the Bengals' defense
 Cincinnati Bengals defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence II (97) sacks Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers (8) in the fourth quarter of the NFL Week 3 game between the Pittsburgh Steelers and the Cincinnati Bengals at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh on Sunday, Sept. 27, 2026. The Bengals fell to 2-1 on the season with a 30-27 loss on the road.
 The rest of Atlanta's offense pushes more targets toward the middle of the field. Drake London draws DJ Turner II, who earned a 91.8 coverage grade against Tennessee and allowed 3 yards on three targets, according to PFF. London is coming off a one-catch game, and Zachariah Branch is out with a hamstring injury , so the targets have to go somewhere.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Up front, the Bengals pressure quarterbacks at the ninth-highest rate in the league (37.5%), according to Bengals.com's scouting report , and Boye Mafe leads the team with 5.5 sacks. Dexter Lawrence collapses the pocket from the middle. Penix gets the ball out in 2.59 seconds, second-fastest in the NFL, which favors the tight end and the backs over deep shots.
 Bijan Robinson will get the first look on the ground against a defense allowing 4.8 yards per carry, the matchup we laid out in our Bijan Robinson expectations . If that works, play-action opens the seams for Pitts. If Atlanta falls behind Joe Burrow early, the volume should be there anyway.
 Our call: start Pitts in 12-team leagues. Sit him only if you have a top-six tight end with a better matchup.
